none: PAS NLM-D09F81: Roman Coin: Nummus, probably of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, probably of Valentinian I (364-375), Victory left issue of Arles mint, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [VALENTINIA]NVS[--]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm, OF I in field. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.8mm, Weight: 2.25gms, die axis: 6
